pull_requests.title: Build an isolated Fire TV candidate with pinned native source inputs
pull_requests.head: perf/firetv-candidate-build-v1
pull_requests.body:
## Purpose

Build a signed, ARMv7 Fire TV test APK from the validated optimization stack, without touching the production branch, publishing a release, or triggering Home Assistant updates.

The isolated workflow runs only on the dedicated candidate branch, fixes the upstream tag to Plezy 2.25.0, and uses Flutter 3.47.9, matching the successful validation run. It verifies the candidate signature against the existing published APK and checks the packaged ABI and removal of the MPV runtime.

## Results

- The parent validation commit passed 181 selected Flutter tests, Dart analysis, source audits, and Android JVM plugin tests: https://github.com/The-Power-0/plezy/actions/runs/40990996465.
- The candidate build at commit `0f910714` passed the tests, release APK build, ABI/MPV checks, Android 9/11 signature checks, and signature comparison against the existing release: https://github.com/The-Power-0/plezy/actions/runs/41155352066.
- The uploaded APK is 81,845,258 bytes versus 172,883,219 bytes for the current published APK. That is a size comparison, not a performance benchmark.
- The APK SHA-256 is `9a4a0cb6abc86be344105b3e3b156f7cb49edd674648b6843ab212abb7b521bf`. Downloaded artifact and component checksums were verified.
- The current and candidate APK manifests both report package `com.edde746.plezy`, version code 1157, and minimum Android API 25.
- Fire OS 7/8 device playback, responsiveness, and installation remain untested.

## Source inputs and documentation

The workflow archives modified Plezy source and separately bundles the pinned mpv-build driver and the FFmpeg, dav1d, OpenSSL, and libdovi source commits referenced by the Android AAR lock. The bundle verifies the AAR against mpv-build's recorded artifact metadata and records archive checksums. Transitive third-party source completeness still requires review before any public release.

The successful build's archived `BUILDING-CUSTOM-FIRE-TV.md` names Flutter 3.47.0, although the build actually used 3.47.9 as recorded in its build-info file. Follow-up commit `9fcd111` corrects that generated documentation and identifies the separate native-source bundle; its document-generation block was tested locally. No APK or application logic changed in that documentation-only follow-up.
pull_requests.archive_disposition: Close as superseded; retain branch and commit history.

pull_requests.title: Validation: execute all stacked Fire TV source overlays in isolated GitHub Actions
pull_requests.head: perf/firetv-validation-v1
pull_requests.body:
## Problem and behavior

The Fire TV optimization PRs are stacked as source overlays. This validation PR applies the combined stack to Plezy 2.25.0 and checks the resulting source before an APK is built.

Disabling Companion Remote also removed the callback that sent the in-player Home action to Plezy's Home tab. The validation overlay registers that navigation independently of the remote service and uses ownership-aware cleanup when profile screens are replaced.

The ExoPlayer-only bridge reports an error if a volume is set before its native core exists. The player now retains the latest requested volume, applies it during initialization, and preserves changes requested while initialization is in flight.

## Validation included

- Applies the stacked overlays and source audits in dependency order.
- Exercises appliance-mode Plex preference request coalescing, profile Home-handler ownership, focus navigation, library browsing, Plex HTTP contracts, device-performance logic and the Dart Android player bridge, including startup volume.
- Runs existing build-flag and shuffle-deep-link tests, targeted Dart analysis, and the Media3-only Android JVM unit test using Plezy's debug test variant, including event and method-channel behavior.
- Documents the complete Fire TV build flags in the generated source instructions.

The exact current head `0534d6ff` passed GitHub source validation, Flutter tests and analysis, and the Android JVM plugin test: https://github.com/The-Power-0/plezy/actions/runs/40990996465.

## Scope

This validation workflow does not build or publish an APK, use signing secrets, merge the optimization stack, or trigger Home Assistant installs. Release packaging, signing verification and Fire OS 7/8 device playback remain separate gates.

pull_requests.body:
## Critical candidate build correctness fix
The inherited manual candidate workflow checked out `ha-shuffle-v2` even when invoked from the selected optimization branch. That checkout lacks the staged overlay scripts and could test different source. This PR changes checkout to the exact selected `${{ github.sha }}`, verifies the commit SHA and required overlay files before checking out upstream Plezy 2.25.0, and adds a source-level guard for provenance and manual-only triggers.

No APK compilation, deployment, GitHub release, branch merge, signing change or Home Assistant updater change. The workflow remains manual-only and continues to archive the generated GPL corresponding source. This PR is stacked after #16 and remains draft.

pull_requests.title: Optimization 08: prevent saved music restoration in Plex movies/TV edition
pull_requests.head: perf/firetv-optimization-08-no-music-restore
pull_requests.body:
Even with the music UI and native MPV audio removed, upstream `MusicPlaybackServiceImpl` could restore a previous music session on profile entry. This Fire TV candidate now supplies `sessionStore: null` when `kFireTvMoviesTvOnly` is enabled, avoiding an obsolete audio-only player initialization and background restore work. It **retains** the shared MusicPlaybackService provider because video playback still consults its audio-focus ownership hooks. Normal Plezy/Windows builds keep their prior restore behavior.

Includes fail-closed source check, documentation and manual-only workflow integration; no build, device validation, merge, or production update. Stacked after #15 for ordered review.

pull_requests.title: Optimization 07: O(1) D-pad action-bar focus-binding lookup
pull_requests.head: perf/firetv-optimization-07-focus-index
pull_requests.body:
Source-only change in the Fire TV candidate: `FocusableActionBarState` currently linearly scans its list of bindings each time a D-pad focus listener fires. This PR adds a binding-identity to index map rebuilt on initial focus creation and action list rebind, using O(1) access during focus-change callbacks. The existing `OwnedFocusNodeBinding` lifecycle, focus restoration, selection, disabled action logic and key routing are retained.

Includes a fail-closed source audit, documentation and integration into the manual-only build workflow. No builds, merges, device testing or performance claims. Stacked after #14; review and merge in order.

## Caveat
The patch has not been applied/compiled on the full checkout and there are no cold-start/frame-time benchmarks yet. Production remains unchanged. Stacked on PR #13; merge only in ordered stack after review.

## Change
- Optimize `LibraryBrowseTab` sliver child key lookup: materialize one ID→sparse index map per sliver rebuild, replacing an O(N) linear scan for every Flutter `findChildIndexCallback` during focus/reconciliation.
- Validate the cached index still points to the expected media ID and fall back to the original scan if a live asynchronous refresh changed the map mid-frame. No persistent invalidation complexity.
- Add source check, documentation, and isolated integration into the manual-only Fire TV candidate workflow. Retain all Plex/HA shuffle behavior.

## Gates
The patch is against exact upstream 2.25.0 and NOT YET applied or Flutter-compiled. No frame benchmarks, APK, production update or device test. Draft PR stacked after #12 for later ordered review and merge.

pull_requests.title: Optimization 03: isolate and disable Watch Together in Plex Fire TV edition
pull_requests.head: perf/firetv-optimization-03-no-watch-together
pull_requests.body:
## Stage 03 — Watch Together runtime removal
Stacked on PR #10 (which stacks on #9 and #8). Does not build, publish, or deploy anything. This is for the custom Plex-only, movies/TV-only, ExoPlayer-only Fire OS 7/8 APK.

### Source overlay
- Introduce opt-in `PLEZY_FIRETV_NO_WATCH_TOGETHER=true` (false by default elsewhere).
- Skip constructing any per-profile WatchTogetherProvider; skip the notice listener subscription and MainScreen room-to-player callbacks.
- Remove the **Watch Together button and participant badge from the local Plex Home toolbar** (preserve Continue Watching, refresh and existing Companion Remote until stage 04).
- Prevent video player binding to a room; suppress all room overlays, controls-header room selector, video settings room item and rate-ownership lookups.
- Skip the room authority selector on the player layout hot path; normal Plex next/previous, seeking, resuming and HA shuffle remain unchanged.
- Hide relay URL settings and hard-refuse attempted room creation or join before any SDK transport, including room navigation calls and agent commands.
- Add positive/default build flag tests and source checks. Wire these as source-preparation steps in the **manual-only** testing workflow, with build define and GPL archive.
- Document remaining reachability work and the complete 16-workstream roadmap.

### Important remaining cleanup
`openwatchparty` and shared Dart room types **remain in the source and dependency manifest**. Removing them outright requires a separate call-site cleanup and compiler validation; this PR is **runtime feature exclusion, not yet complete SDK/binary deletion**. No APK size or speed improvement is claimed. The PR is intentionally draft and source anchors have been checked against upstream Plezy 2.25.0.

### Safety
No changes to production `ha-shuffle-v2`, published `Plezy.apk`, signing key or Home Assistant updater. No build was triggered. Next feature phase: Plezy Remote removal.

pull_requests.title: Optimization 02: remove Discord Rich Presence from Plex Fire TV edition
pull_requests.head: perf/firetv-optimization-02-no-discord
pull_requests.body:
## Purpose
Second staged feature-removal PR, stacked on #9 (which is stacked on #8). **No build, release, or deployment in this PR.** This is the Plex-only, movies/TV-only, ExoPlayer-only Fire TV variant; ordinary Plezy/possible Windows variants remain unchanged.

## Actual source changes (applied later against pinned upstream 2.25.0)
- `.github/patches/apply_firetv_remove_discord.py` removes the `dart_discord_presence` dependency, Discord IPC implementation, Discord-only tests/fakes and all playback/desktop startup uses.
- Removes the video **playback-rate listener used exclusively for Discord**, plus start/stop/pause/resume/position event handling on both video and the dormant music path.
- Removes Discord settings controls and mutation side effects; direct agent settings calls explicitly report unsupported.
- Keeps the inert saved preference key so old user preferences aren't destructively migrated; retains Plex's native watch/resume tracking, OS media controls, and HA shuffle deep links.
- Updates the mixed music test by removing only the two Discord-specific tests; leaves unrelated music tests intact, and removes the deleted service from the network-security source scan.
- Adds `.github/patches/check_firetv_no_discord_source.py` to reject remaining runtime imports, package dependency, startup initializer and Discord-only stream listener.
- Wires removal + audit into the manual-only `firetv-no-mpv-candidate.yml` source-preparation step, with the exact modified source included in the later GPL archive.
- Adds a detailed Stage 02 design note and updates the 16-workstream roadmap.

## Source review evidence and remaining gates
The source removal's 32 original anchors and two extra settings import anchors were compared against upstream 2.25.0 and matched exactly once. **This is not a compile or runtime test.** Source overlays have not been executed on a full checkout, no Dart/Gradle build has been run, and no Fire Stick has been updated. During the later permitted build we must inspect resolved Dart deps/lockfile, compile tests, signing, APK and on-device behavior.

## Next step
Stage 03: remove Watch Together room synchronization and UI while preserving ordinary Plex player controls and episode queue transitions. This PR stays draft until stacked dependencies and tests are validated.

pull_requests.title: Optimization 01: disable cloud Discover, Seerr requests and external trackers on Plex Fire TV
pull_requests.head: perf/firetv-optimization-01-external-services
pull_requests.body:
## Purpose
First source-stage of the agreed **16-workstream Fire TV optimization plan**, stacked on unmerged PR #8. The target is Plex movies and TV with ExoPlayer, no music, no Jellyfin and no external catalog/request/tracker services.

## Important Discover distinction
**Preserves `DiscoverScreen` / `DiscoverProvider` as local Plex Home**, including Continue Watching and Plex server home hubs. Only `discover.provider.plex.tv`, external Explore catalogs/watchlists and Seerr request surfaces are excluded.

## Stage 01 source overlay
- Opt-in `PLEZY_FIRETV_NO_EXTERNAL_SERVICES=true`, default false in normal builds.
- Bypass Trakt, MAL, AniList, Simkl, MDBList, Seerr profile hydration and Plex cloud Discover session acquisition; keep providers available to avoid breaking shared navigation and playback code.
- Hide external catalog sources and `Explore`, suppress Seerr background permission refresh, and hide now-empty Services settings screen.
- Disable `TrackerCoordinator` outgoing tracker list and persisted write queue replay, preserving **Plex's own** watched state and local Home features.
- Preserve stored third-party credentials rather than deleting them; normal Plezy builds retain existing behavior.
- Add positive/negative build-flag tests and a source-level audit checking the required guards, with wiring into the existing **manual-only** Fire TV candidate workflow. No workflow dispatched.
- Document the complete 16-workstream plan and other requested removal phases (Discord RPC, Watch Together and Plezy Remote).

## Limitations & next steps
Source patch is committed but not applied, compiled or device-tested. Unreachable source files may remain in the checkout; APK and runtime savings are **not yet measured**. Stage 02 will remove Discord Rich Presence; Stage 03 Watch Together; Stage 04 Plezy Remote, each as a separate stacked PR. After these and the 16 optimization stages are reviewed, run the candidate build and real-device regression tests. This PR does not change the production GitHub workflow, published `Plezy.apk`, signing key, or Home Assistant updater.
pull_requests.archive_disposition: Close as superseded; retain branch and commit history.

pull_requests.title: Fire TV Plex movies and TV: remove MPV player and use ExoPlayer-only runtime
pull_requests.head: perf/firetv-no-mpv-movies-tv-v1
pull_requests.body:
## User-specific scope
Plex **movies and TV only** (no music), 32-bit ARM Fire OS 7/8. This removes the need to migrate MPV's gapless music implementation. Production release / Home Assistant updater remain unchanged.

## Code changes
- Reviewed `ExoPlayerPlugin.kt` replacement implements the existing Dart Media3 method/event channels, ExoPlayer-only video surface, subtitle styling, audio decoding/passthrough, and a terminal unsupported-format error with **no native MPV fallback**.
- `apply_firetv_mpv_retirement.py` patches the exact upstream 2.25.0 checkout after existing HA shuffle + Plex-only + forced-ExoPlayer overlays; removes MPV native Kotlin implementation and plugin registration, disables legacy MPV music factory on this build, strips fallback-event plumbing and redundant MPV filter updates, and retains media3 decoder recovery.
- Gradle removes `implementation(mpvAarDependency)` so native MPV player, MPV JNI glue, and player classes are **not linked into the APK**. The pinned AAR is retained as a **build-time-only source of FFmpeg audio decoder libraries** (not an MPV player). Preserve libass/libdovi/FFmpeg for movies/TV.
- Adds a manual-only, separate `Fire TV No-MPV Plex Movies and TV Test` workflow. Release-AOT ARMv7 build, source overlay validation, shuffle and Dart tests, no-MPV native library ZIP rejection, FFmpeg JNI presence check, signing certificate compatibility, exact GPL source archive and uniquely named test artifact.
- Adds detailed migration/provenance and regression documentation.

## Status / caution
**Source code is committed, NOT yet compiled, built, installed, or tested on physical Fire Sticks.** This PR remains draft until source preparation, Kotlin/Gradle compilation and codec/surround/subtitle testing pass. The source includes a build-time mpv-android AAR only for FFmpeg extraction, and does not claim standalone FFmpeg binary provenance yet. Plex automatic transcoding of every unsupported file is not established; the preserved normal error path is used instead of MPV fallback.

## Safety
Do not merge this PR into the release workflow or publish an APK before the candidate build passes; the existing production `Plezy.apk`, keystore, release URL, licensing, and Home Assistant update automation are unchanged.

## Additional source-only review (October 28)
- Moved from a proposed relocation to **complete removal** of the MPV-exclusive `createOsdSurface` code and `GlCapabilities` probe; retained ExoPlayer's shared `createVideoSurface`, subtitle layers and frame-rate machinery.
- Removed stale Android MPV debug/instrumentation sources and resolver tests that would otherwise reference deleted classes.
- Added separate `PLEZY_FIRETV_MOVIES_TV_ONLY` build flag, filtering music libraries and hiding the mini-player/music context controls without touching the standard Plex-only build.
- Added fail-closed Python source audit for dangling MPV imports, player registrations, source-archive requirements and the native decoder inputs; wired it to run before Gradle.
- Added normal-build and movies/TV-only Dart flag tests; native tests cover terminal format failure and backend identity.
- **No GitHub Actions candidate build has been started**, and the PR intentionally remains draft. Native compilation, library packaging and codec behavior remain unverified.
